low_ipm_exclusion.rationale: Near-zero pile of 398 shots (12.4%) at ipm2c < 200; they carry median 41 photon pixels vs 6448 in the normal group and contribute 0.73% of the signal but 12.3% of the noise variance. Operator hint: cut at 200 (gap between pile and body), keeping the 200-3000 mid-band. Since mid-band is retained, normalization form must be ratio_of_sums (per-shot division outside the linear plateau amplifies the +10% ratio bias in the mid-band, worsening bin-CV from 13.1% to 16.3%).

high_ipm_exclusion.rationale: Operator hint: RUN at p99 to match the human baseline convention (Taekeun's calibration sum). Drops 32 shots above ipm2(raw) = 31221. Linearity evidence: det_total/ipm2 ratio is flat at ~21e-6 from ipm2c 3700 to p99, no droop; no signal-driven gain switching (LaB6 signal ~0.01 photons/pixel, well below the 34-photon G0 headroom). The cut is protective/baseline-compatible, not evidence-driven.

normalization.rationale: Bin-CV test (8 chronological bins, 2746 kept shots after both selection cuts): unnormalized 13.10%, per-shot-ipm2 16.32% (WORSE, because 997 mid-band shots at ipm2c 200-3000 have a +10% det/ipm2c ratio bias vs plateau), ratio-of-sums 3.25% (drift removed without amplifying mid-band bias). r(det_total, ipm2c) = 0.893 over kept shots. Ratio-of-sums is the correct form when the kept set includes sub-plateau shots (36.3% of kept), as the operator hint in 01a anticipates. ipm2 offset = 4.50 (median over 24 xray-off shots). Residual bin-CV ~3.3% is the systematic floor (pointing/spectral drift no scalar monitor can remove).

anomalies: ipmfex26_ch1 saturated at ~1.21 const — poisons ipmfex26_sum (r drops 0.91->0.61)
monitor_choice.rationale: ipm2 and ipmfex22_sum statistically tied (3.42% vs 3.41% bin-CV, r 0.895 vs 0.909). Keeping ipm2 as verdict because all documented thresholds (low-cut 200/3000, offsets) are written against it; switching monitors redefines every threshold for no measurable gain. ipmfex22_sum is the cross-check (different electronics — diode box vs wave8).

photon_energy.rationale: Jitter 6.4 eV rms = 0.067% = 0.56 px blur at outermost ring, far below the 5 px tolerance. Single energy setpoint, no scan. Machine absolute (9564 eV) disagrees with geometry lambda (9600 eV) by +0.38%, but measured ring deltas are 0/0/+1/-1 px — rings refute the machine absolute. No correction warranted.

residual_attribution.rationale: No recorded channel explains the post-normalization residual (joint per-shot R2 = 0.0%). The ~3.3% bin-CV floor is plausibly sample/illumination-footprint or SASE spectral structure invisible to scalar diagnostics. Legitimate mitigation is pump-on/off referencing, not a division by uncorrelated signals.
